visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a highly specialized placodont with a square, turtle-like shell and a boxy head.
visual_logic.environment: Shallow, shimmering hypersaline water reflecting a pale violet sunset.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE; light positioned to emphasize the extreme flatness and width of the carapace.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: A very broad, square-shaped snout profile with no visible neck, as it is tucked into the shell line.

pose: Top-down 'plan' view swimming just below the surface to maximize the square-shaped silhouette of the shell and the tiny, protruding tail.
negative_constraints: No internal shell patterns; the silhouette must appear as a solid, slightly rounded square with four small flippers.
